svg.aria-label: Meet the crew: three read-only agents on a turntable. wiki-ingest reads a source and returns page drafts, wiki-lint runs the vault health check, verifier tests a change and ranks findings. They read and report; only the transaction core writes to your Obsidian vault, once.
svg.title: Meet the crew: three read-only agents on a turntable. wiki-ingest reads a source and returns page drafts, wiki-lint runs the vault health check, verifier tests a change and ranks findings. They read and report; only the transaction core writes to your Obsidian vault, once.
svg.text: They read and report. Only the core writes.

g.text: Returns page drafts and expected hashes.
Hands drafts back. Never applies them.
Reports only. Never repairs the vault.
Checks a proposed change or release.
Runs safe tests, ranks findings by evidence.
Only the core writes to your vault.
